verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API, and its official MCP server (remote and local, with a read-only mode) claims agent access to the full Square API platform, so an agent can plausibly pull payout data. Nothing in the evidence shows payout-entry or balance-transaction detail that ties each bank deposit to its underlying payments, so per-deposit reconciliation is unproven. The Payouts API itself appears only as a page title. Missing for 10: documented payout-entry/balance-transaction data linking deposits to individual charges, explicit payouts coverage in the MCP service catalog, a reconciliation workflow example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
